current_arms.control: nineteen shipped poloidal conductors plus the shipped bcoil channel used by the toroidal-field source
current_arms.full: the same shipped channels plus ECOILB, E567UP, E567DN, E89UP and E89DN driven from shipped ECOILA by the fixed-wiring pf_active circuit

label_distance.measure: gauge-aligned RMS on the labelled LCFS interior divided by the whole labelled-map range
label_distance.role: diagnostic only; never included in the pass criterion

measurement: diverted free-boundary root with complete current set
pass_criterion: finite terminal receipt AND relative residual <= 1e-6 AND unpinned terminal topology classified diverted

selection.polarity_screen: every shot is absent from the landed 603-shot affected population
selection.rule: the five distinct-shot replacement frames already banked by the boundary-current recovery measurement; only shot and frame are read, never its label-recovered current prescriptions

solver.seed: the convention-clean labelled map, used only to select the diverted branch; it is not an equilibrium input
